parameters.content:
# ShiftHub — 3-Hour Unconfirmed Escalation

THE SIWES 'done when' flow.

Every 15 minutes, checks for shifts starting in ~3 hours whose confirmation is still PENDING. Alerts the SUPERVISOR by email + Telegram with the names, wards and times, and stamps `escalation3hSent` so the alert goes out once.

nodes.name: Pivot Settings
nodes.notes: Pivots key|value rows into a settings object.

nodes.name: Select At-Risk Shifts
nodes.notes: One item per PENDING assignment starting in 165-195 minutes.

nodes.name: Build Supervisor Alert
nodes.notes: Aggregates all at-risk rows into one email/Telegram and keeps the per-row ids.

nodes.name: Alert Supervisor (Telegram)
nodes.notes: Best-effort Telegram notification; failure does not stop the run.

nodes.name: Alert Supervisor (Email)
nodes.notes: SMTP send (Gmail app password). All ShiftHub mails go from the facility mailbox.

nodes.name: Restore At-Risk Rows
nodes.notes: Re-expands the at-risk rows so each one can be stamped after the alert was delivered.

nodes.name: Mark Escalation Sent
nodes.notes: Stamps the row so the supervisor is alerted only once per shift.
